question: With which neighbouring country does India share the Sunderbans forest?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bangladesh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sunderbands Forest:-**

 
 
• The name of the Sundarbans forest has been drawn from a mangrove plant known as Sundari (Heritiera Minor). 
 
• This park has been declared as a UNESCO heritage site Because it attracts tourists to this place.
 
• The forest of the Sundarbans is located in the world's largest delta, which is formed by three rivers named the Ganges, Brahmaputra, and Meghna.
 
• **India shares the Sunderbans forest with its neighboring country, Bangladesh. **
 
• The Sunderbans Delta is the only mangrove forest in the world inhabited by tigers.
 
• For its preservation, Discovery India and World Wide Fund (WWF) India partnered with the Government of West Bengal and local communities in the Sundarbans in 2019.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** The neighboring countries of India:**

 
 
• Pakistan - Located to the northwest, sharing a land border with India.
 
• China - Lies to the northeast, sharing a border in the Himalayan region.
 
• Nepal - Located to the north, sharing an open border with India.
 
• Bhutan - Lies to the northeast, sharing a land border with India.
 
• Bangladesh - Located to the east, sharing a border in the northeastern and eastern regions.
 
• Myanmar (Burma) - Lies to the southeast, sharing a border in the northeastern region.
 
• Sri Lanka - Though separated by the sea, Sri Lanka is India's neighboring country in the south, across the Palk Strait.
